name: Jamie Davis (D-LA)
subject: I’m the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY RESIST RECLAIM REBUILD PAC (WWW
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Both of my parents were raised on farms in Tensas Parish, Louisiana. My father by a sharecropper and my mother on a plantation.
They picked cotton by hand. For them it was survival and my grandparents did not believe that a formal education was necessary. For them missing school to go to work on the farm was the norm.
The only time my Dad could go to school was when the weather was so bad that nothing could be done on the farm. Kids would tease him saying, "Must be raining cause Stump (his nickname) is here and not at the farm."
The highest level of education my dad reached was the 8th grade but despite this, his informal education taught him to run a successful farm and he became the first in our family to own land.
My Dad gave me the opportunity to chart a different course and I was the first person in my family to graduate from high school and I went on to attend LSU.
Ultimately, Baton Rouge was too big a city with too much temptation for the farm boy from the country town of Waterproof and I returned home with my tail between my legs, sent back on academic probation with my first child on the way.
My father asked me sarcastically, "What are you going to do now Mr. Man?” And I told him earnestly, "I'm going to farm just like you do."
And that’s what I’ve been doing to this day. Starting off with the 220 acres that my Dad leased, we worked to grow the farm to where we stand today — farming 3,200 acres, 700 of which belong to my family.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
Unfortunately, in my 55 years of life here in Louisiana much has changed for the worse. Life has been sucked out of our small towns by monopolies like Dollar General and Walmart. Agriculture has become far less profitable, dominated by big business, and I have watched all of my Dad’s friends that were black farmers go out of business.
Our beloved home is turning into something unrecognizable. Louisianans on both sides of the aisle recognize this and they are ready for radical change.
I have to take a stand and fight for the way of life that we had when I grew up here as a boy and it’s why I am proud to be the Democrat running for Senate in Louisiana.
Dems can win here statewide — look no further than our last Governor, Democrat John Bel Edwards. And now a blue wave is forming, putting Louisiana in play for Democrats like me who can articulate an authentic vision of FDR-style economic populism that can compete with and defeat the fake populism of MAGA.
Taking this seat means electing Louisiana's first black senator and statewide elected official since reconstruction. It means we reclaim the Senate with an unshakeable majority — the Trump administration goes down in flames when we pull this off. Winning Louisiana is now possible and it’s why I’m asking you to join us in this last stand with a donation of $25, $10, or even just $5 to help Democrats take this now within reach Senate seat. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
CHIP IN TO FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-jamie]
We have the opportunity to pull off something historic in Louisiana that will do a whole lot of good for people here. I couldn’t be more grateful to have you fighting alongside me.
Jamie Davis
Democrat for U.S. Senate

This is a comprehensive strategic approach to fight back against the GOP redistricting crisis
| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731249/625488906/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwMWZmM2VlLTcyNjAtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bSS8YofywDGCZYar9sJuEv_2ACrdsnPsh8gz45XWv0M=&emci=52052439-2860-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=701ff3ee-7260-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045)

Peter, As we write this, Democrats remain poised to take back the House of Representatives this fall. That simply would not be true if our movement didn’t fight back when Donald Trump unleashed an unprecedented attempt to gerrymander states across the country. If we had not rapidly mobilized, Congress would have been locked in Republican hands for the foreseeable future. But the bad news is now that the Supreme Court has gutted voting rights protections, we are entering a new stage of this crisis — one that is shamelessly rooted in insidious racial discrimination. **This poses an existential threat to American voters: denying the people the right to choose their government and enabling rampant corruption by limiting voters’ ability to hold politicians accountable. ** **The good news is we have a rigorous, multi-front strategy to defeat Trump’s gerrymandering and protect our democracy.** You can [**read all about the plan here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731250/625488907/-367685688?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwMWZmM2VlLTcyNjAtZjExMS04ZmNiLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bSS8YofywDGCZYar9sJuEv_2ACrdsnPsh8gz45XWv0M=&emci=52052439-2860-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&emdi=701ff3ee-7260-f111-8fcb-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045), but it breaks states down into three areas of focus:
* **Defend** : Fight back everywhere Republicans have passed — or might soon pursue — new gerrymanders. This requires every tool in the toolbox, from ballot initiatives to strategic legal action to voter education and mobilization. Wherever Republicans try to bend our democracy to secure power, we’ll be doing everything in our power to stop them.
* **Counter** : Just as voters have done in California and Utah, we’ll pursue assertive and responsible countermeasures in states to ensure the national congressional map reflects the true will of the people.
* **Advance** : Several states currently hang in the balance with divided government or state courts whose majorities are up for grabs in the elections ahead. We’re building a proactive electoral strategy to shore up Democratic trifectas, independent judiciaries, and legislative or gubernatorial firewalls that can prevent the next Trump-led gerrymander before it starts.

This is not a moment for tiny tweaks or small ambitions. clean_body: This is a comprehensive strategic approach to fight back against the GOP redistricting crisis | Peter, As we write this, Democrats remain poised to take back the House of Representatives this fall. That simply would not be true if our movement didn’t fight back when Donald Trump unleashed an unprecedented attempt to gerrymander states across the country. If we had not rapidly mobilized, Congress would have been locked in Republican hands for the foreseeable future. But the bad news is now that the Supreme Court has gutted voting rights protections, we are entering a new stage of this crisis — one that is shamelessly rooted in insidious racial discrimination. This poses an existential threat to American voters: denying the people the right to choose their government and enabling rampant corruption by limiting voters’ ability to hold politicians accountable. The good news is we have a rigorous, multi-front strategy to defeat Trump’s gerrymandering and protect our democracy. You can , but it breaks states down into three areas of focus: Defend : Fight back everywhere Republicans have passed — or might soon pursue — new gerrymanders. This requires every tool in the toolbox, from ballot initiatives to strategic legal action to voter education and mobilization. Wherever Republicans try to bend our democracy to secure power, we’ll be doing everything in our power to stop them. Counter : Just as voters have done in California and Utah, we’ll pursue assertive and responsible countermeasures in states to ensure the national congressional map reflects the true will of the people. Advance : Several states currently hang in the balance with divided government or state courts whose majorities are up for grabs in the elections ahead. We’re building a proactive electoral strategy to shore up Democratic trifectas, independent judiciaries, and legislative or gubernatorial firewalls that can prevent the next Trump-led gerrymander before it starts. This is not a moment for tiny tweaks or small ambitions. Defeating this onslaught of partisan and racial gerrymanders demands that we throw out outdated playbooks and work with the American people to level the playing field. subject: 🌶️ Friend, do you like green chile salsa? 🌶️

body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=jtk846-fr-ndem-header&t=1&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
---
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. This week, we made history by winning all 33 counties in New Mexico and **officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor.** I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10451?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
---
Today, this victory feels deeply personal. It brings me back to the kitchen table conversations that shaped my values long before I began fighting for working families. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community.

One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10451?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)
Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of Governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**
[**_Pl_** _**ease, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now to help me become the next Governor. When you click this link and donate, I'll share my own green chile salsa recipe with you! >>**_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/10452?refcode=jtk846-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10132%2E400544%2EHjaoGn)

clean_body: | | | Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. This week, we made history by winning all 33 counties in New Mexico and officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor. I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead. | | Today, this victory feels deeply personal. It brings me back to the kitchen table conversations that shaped my values long before I began fighting for working families. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community. One of my favorite New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me. I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state. Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico. I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment. That’s the kind of Governor I will be. I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico. | | Thank you for your support, Deb | | | | |

---
Peter, Okay — we got some BIG news for you. Yesterday, Becca helped force a vote on Trump’s unauthorized war in Iran. **And guess what? We won.** The House voted 215–208 to pass a War Powers Resolution directing Trump to end U.S. military involvement in Iran unless Congress explicitly authorizes it. **That means a majority of the House — including four Republicans — voted to say: No, Mr. President, you do not get to drag us into war while Congress sits quietly in the corner.** That is exactly the kind of fight Becca came to Congress for. And it is exactly the kind of fight we need your help sustaining. [_**If you’re fired up about this win, will you consider clicking here and pitching in $5, $10, or $25 today to help keep Becca in Congress fighting with everything she got for peace, accountability, and working people?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731311/625494565/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=) Here’s the thing: Becca didn’t just show up yesterday and cast a vote. She helped lead this fight. **Back in April, she introduced a War Powers Resolution because she saw what was happening and refused to let Congress shrug its shoulders while Trump put service members in danger, blew through taxpayer dollars, and tried to normalize another unauthorized war.** **[HELP FUEL THE FIGHT](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731312/625494566/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=)** That is what leadership looks like. Not a strongly worded tweet. Not a cable news soundbite. Actual strategy. Actual pressure. Actual votes. And now, because Becca and her colleagues kept pushing, the House has sent a message loud enough for the White House to hear: **You are not a king and the constitution is NOT optional.** Meanwhile, Trump’s team requested **$350 billion** in additional funding for this war. **$350 billion.** That is roughly the cost of extending Affordable Care Act tax credits for another ten years. So when Becca says this is about priorities, she means it. We can fund health care. We can lower costs. We can invest in housing, child care, climate, schools, and the communities that keep this country running. Or we can keep shoveling mountains of money into an unauthorized war that Congress never approved and the American people never asked for. **Becca knows which side she’s on. And so do we.** But here’s the part we need to be real about: when Becca takes on war, corporate greed, right-wing extremism, and the people who think Congress should be a rubber stamp, she paints a target on her back. **So we need to have hers.** _**[If you can, will you click here and make a contribution today to help us defend Becca’s seat and keep this kind of fearless leadership in Congress?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/132731313/625494567/-925757083?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2FjNjU3ZS03NDYwLWYxMTEtOGZjYi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhMeXys87pLXHml5iS_erEXcVY7l8aD3aIthXRVkuYY=)**_ The Senate needs to act next. This fight is not over. **But yesterday proved something important: when we organize, push, and refuse to back down, we can force Congress to move.** Becca is doing her part. Now let’s try our best to do ours! **Thank you from the bottom of our heart for always having our back.** — Team Becca

body:
We’re reaching out one more time ...
| | Peter – we fell just short of our crucial signature goal, so we wanted to reach out one more time.
---
With this race heating up, Roy needs to know if you’re in his corner. **[Please add your name right now to personally endorse Roy as we fight to flip North Carolina blue and win back the Senate for Democrats.>>](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=6&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)**
Thanks in advance for strengthening our people-powered movement.

Team Cooper
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Roy Cooper (via Cooper Victory Fund)**
Date: Jun 2, 2026
Subject: Will you add your name, Peter?
| | |
---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=7&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)
Peter, I’ve been crisscrossing the state on my Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour, talking with and listening to North Carolinians directly, and I keep hearing versions of the same thing:
🚨 Everything from gas to groceries is getting unaffordable.

🏠 Buying a house and planning for the future seems unthinkable.

🇺🇲 The American Dream feels unattainable.
**Stuff costs too much, and nobody in Washington DC seems to care.**
When I hear things like this, I know it’s time to get to work. That’s why I’m in this fight. As North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator, I will put the people before power, party and politics – as I did for eight years as Governor:
✅ We expanded Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians.

✅ We added hundreds of thousands of good-paying jobs.

✅ We increased teacher pay and expanded paid parental leave.
**Now, I’m ready to bring this North Carolina common sense to the U.S. Senate – but I need your help. The GOP is going all in to defeat me, and only by building a powerful grassroots team can I fight back and win.**
[_Peter, will you add your name now to personally endorse my campaign for Senate? I’m aiming to gather 25,000 signatures before the end of the day, and it would mean a lot to have you with me in this fight._](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/mscl-endorse-cooper-0626-email/?source=email_su_pros_jtk462&ask=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&refcode=email_su_pros_jtk464&t=8&akid=1649%2E124072%2EUpKLyo)

Thank you,

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

subject: Chutzpah
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action
body:
|
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c)_

[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=4&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) Peter, it’s Elaine Luria, and Blue Amp Action said I could reach out because it’s a pivotal moment for our campaign. The Virginia Supreme Court struck down the new congressional map that Virginia voters passed in April. [**So, our race just became even more crucial to our battle for the House Majority. Before I get into my background and how I’m fighting back, will you split a $25 donation to flip VA-02?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=5&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c) | [DONATE $25 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/11036?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.04_Luria-Chutzpah_B5_F1_S18_C18_90AC-365DON_RS-T0&t=6&akid=2422%2E259176%2EH5Nq8c)
---
_Chutzpah_ — is a Yiddish term that means _guts_ or _courage._
In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama.
That took some serious _chutzpah._
My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind.
That promise came true for him. He built a life, a family, and a proud community.
That’s what sets America apart, Peter. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed.
In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms.
In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them.
In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous.
In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened.
In 2026, I’m running for Congress again, because our current representative either _can’t_ or _won’t_ protect them.
The fact is that Coastal Virginia is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It’s time for action.**
Flipping Virginia’s Second District won’t be easy. Dark money groups and super PACs are watching closely, trying to see if we’re strong enough to pose a real threat. **This will be one of the toughest fights of the 2026 election cycle.**
Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family. I’m not afraid of a little _mishigas._ And with you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need.

Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win.
Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode.
There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to?

Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane.

clean_body: Plus: Why this race could be over by the Fourth of July | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com | | | | | | | | | | | | `Gregg Hull just won the GOP nomination for New Mexico governor in a real stunner — outspent 3-to-1 by Doug Turner, who had been closing fast in the final week. by riding huge support across the Albuquerque metro.`` ``Now it's Hull vs. Haaland — and she just buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout of her own.` | | 🔥 HULL TAKES THE GOP — KRYSTY WAS RIGHT! Turner outspent Hull 3-to-1. Pre-election polling had Turner closing fast. Most everyone expected him to win. Most everyone except Krysty. She made the call a couple shows back — and we play the clip in this episode. There's one question Jay and Mark dig into that nobody else is asking: did the third candidate hand Hull the nomination without even meaning to? 🔵 HAALAND THUMPS BREGMAN — NOW SHE GOES UNDERGROUND Deb Haaland buried Sam Bregman in a primary blowout. She now has $2 million in the bank and a strategy that's going to drive every Republican in the state insane. Jay's words on her general election plan: she's going to make Joe Biden look like the greatest retail politician ever. And the warning Jay delivers next should keep Hull's team up at night. | | | 🎯 HULL'S PUNCHER'S CHANCE — AND THE 2006 PLAYBOOK Hull has a path. Mark and Jay walk through it — and Jay keeps coming back to one race: Heather Wilson, 2006. The catch is a -26 generic ballot in Albuquerque. Hull starts the general in a deep hole. This is important: This week, it’s been reported that Donald Trump is going to drop his $1.8 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund for his criminal friends... because of you .
You spoke out, you refused to back down, and it worked. Donald Trump is not immune to public pressure. Don’t ever think your voice doesn’t matter, because it does, and this win is proof.
I know it can feel like nothing we do makes a drop of difference against an administration and a president this brazen and corrupt. Using the Justice Department to make Trump and his family untouchable, and to cover up the horrific crimes in the Epstein files. Trying to create a billion-dollar slush fund for insurrectionists using your taxpayer dollars. It would be hard to believe, if we didn’t see it with our own eyes.
But public pressure works, and that’s exactly why we keep fighting. So we’ll speak out and do everything we can to stop, delay, and blunt the harm from this administration in the short term — but what stops it permanently is losing power , and in November we can make that happen.
Flipping the House means real subpoena power, real oversight, and the ability to demand answers from an administration that has spent two years trying to make itself untouchable.
No one — not even the President of the United States — is above the law, and in November we can make sure he knows it. But we need to build up our resources to get there. Will you chip in to our campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

Fellow American,
I can't thank you enough.
I am beyond grateful for your support. It is the fuel that keeps our campaign moving.
I wake up every morning driven by a single purpose: making a real difference in your life and protecting the values we hold dear in Maine.
When I made the decision to run, I knew the attacks would be relentless. I am confident in my decision because I know I am not standing alone.
You have my back, and I have yours.
Together, we are a firewall protecting our common sense decisions. Again, thank you for standing with me. I would not be where I am today without your support.
Sincerely,
Susan Collins

There is something about May that feels uniquely American

| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
### There is something about May that feels uniquely American. School years come to an end, the days stretch a little longer, and communities start spending more time outside with friends and neighbors. We also got one final snowstorm - a reminder that seasons rarely change all at once.
###
### This campaign is a lot like that.
###
### The work of building momentum doesn’t happen overnight. It happens conversation by conversation, county by county, and neighbor by neighbor. This month we traveled the district, met with voters, heard more concerns and we are building the momentum to win in November... Thank you for being here.
---
| |
### Best, Eileen.
---

| | We started May by hosing or attending**six meet and greets in four different counties**. I ended the month with three days in Highlands Ranch handing out poppies with my friend Bob Marshall and attending three Memorial Day events around Douglas County in celebrations of service and sacrifice.
Last week, **I visited with the workers currently locked out from their jobs at the Cargill meat packing facility in Fort Morgan**. Lauren Boebert has never supported the men and women in our communities who work tirelessly to package the meat raised here in our district. Thank you to Teamsters Local 455 for organizing on behalf of these meatpackers for fair wages and safe working conditions. I also heard from many about the impacts the drought and other geo-political and economic conditions are having on our beef supply.
It was great to **join with community for Douglas County Pridefest** in Parker. It was POURING rain, but that did not stop us!
This month I also continued my tour of various health centers in our district and spent some time with Brian in South Loveland **checking out the services Sunrise Community Health Center in provides**. The incredible team at Sunrise is dedicated to expanding access to quality, affordable health care. The service they provide is so necessary.
---

Speaking of service, I am honored to announce a **collaboration with Nancy Lacore and Leela Gray**. Nancy is running for Congress in SC-01 and Leela is running in FL-13. Nancy served our country in the United States Navy for 35 years and Leela in the Army for 30 years. Together, we have six stars, hence we are calling our collaboration [**Six Stars**](https://us.list-manage.com/Zvh5QmLpyJ8?e=1c5f08419c&c2id=9f711ebcee4618a2092828a4c98e410a).
I am honored to collaborate with these two incredible women. Their dedication to service and willingness to continually step up for their communities is inspiring. I hope together, we can lead our districts, and our nation, to **better opportunities for all.**

## Blanche Faces Senate Fight for AG Post
President Trump announced he will [nominate acting Attorney General Todd Blanche](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCngc5osfktXFxDl2uvRBt7AUf-QXgTjrc_Ja9w9Uij-ebnNt_QeRfXbwykeUlzpDN7YqZj5uMZ9oiBcqQTV7SEvBmfzCxBdgI6Ae1s0flrbkqrFyJJqiRd9wN0bQNNW26aBqotdv0ythYAxsaYblCklGzJjNaUTr_boIO2BuhlU7UK5FCbu6rJjGocigbIOk5H9Ugu8kaLv9KLjsqkUHq9Me-5UF-FnAo5nedZLen3rXjnhZz25B07kws5fUAi45XFRiKm4CIyCTTs4ipwFZysFXeP0WwkdjoCRorsL-EJrXg8MztDwtKOBweKXB7a7qfz3uWuLxpYAzr_2cX_OvOl5V8AAAD__3lTjJY) to permanently lead the Justice Department, elevating his former defense attorney to the nation's top law enforcement role. Blanche faces [resistance in his own party](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2upDAQhE9jMlDjHxgCB5uQzaYbosZuwCtjI9wzaG7_xFzhJZVUqar0_XtOTwwxpPUv7mR5yVOiq0RipnPi87UfCXcqiS5c0RPy5mJ2kwTZ1dDVYCaPIX4mXXm7EElSFdm2f0BnNGhTbXZwM3pNoLrZmF75RXW9GlAPrVxcq3QV7N0GHZgWoJe6MQrko3WzaskNangIDeQD57P5n0PijZb4yW86G5f3KtqN-ShC_RFyFHK8rqs5cgwcXL4DQo4xvKl-HR6ZipDjvSbkCF_RQo4up_WkcntzxOQ2KvUrOToZQ6oP5K0GGAwYNVSn9ccVYgyl64WGdccQvz_4V_DeVv4EAAD__9cUgQY) on the Senate Judiciary Committee, where he can lose only one Republican vote and multiple GOP members remain uncommitted, largely over the issue of the administration's controversial $1.776 billion Anti-Weaponization Fund Blanche told lawmakers that the fund was dead, but [refused to put it in writing.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp_GdET-wfwULlZa0WW13ZZosAeY1WAjmCTK21_lvsKtP-k7OufffboDMeX1D-wYZClTxtfFKILnJOdjPzLseGV8wQoJQbbIJU5W27bWba39lID4PTVVCguiRVdhMF2vW9_oxldbcNF4SIMznen0MLS2hwWNnWOajW-HWFH4vOlWe6N1Z5ubd9r2Js7OYBzc0KtGYyIp5-1_oSwbLvwuTzxvsewVh03kuJT7peyo7Ahz_Bh8NmXHv4VJKF7KjjNDjhtedS47ZRAquYa1fhwbMdcziDAqO15SzrdyIyXlfhvnfD90na3OkI4XMdPVdqrR6w7E33z5UbRnsF8BAAD__8bff-E) Trump then told reporters he didn't know if the fund was truly finished, calling it "a beautiful thing." ## Screwworm Confirmed in South Texas
[Federal officials confirmed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu5CAMhp8m6RgZEiAUFNtMN9tuGRkwEyRyEaC5vP0qKc4LnO63LH329_97zA9MOW3Pv7iSbZ-4zxu9a6bWqJzxvZccqi9XWtPW6IN1mQUIxUAxkHPAlL_z2AfrIBjek-V6AiX1IMZ-sSCi59FpI4HrCYegwZtoJk0wiIG7PtkTBgok5yBguAkIJuIAODnvlOLdCBRS28utLXTdj_m7v6jc_L722S6tHbUb_nTi3ok7HqfAuTqH0pLP1In7jwKLmerCCFvanuzAgjU1Yh5by8QuPBMUvSSvTDBKcic9OHTjJCQFHI1WfbHheKecU1W6G-G5YsrXN-13Hb6s-B8AAP__-SGG2w) the first New World screwworm case in Texas since 1966. The flesh-eating parasite was found in a 3-week-old calf in La Pryor, Zavala County, about 50 miles from the Mexican border. Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins [announced the detection on Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkTGOpTAMhk8DnZ-cEAKvoNiGbrbdEhnHGSIF8pRkh5nbr2BXe4HpftvyZ33yr7fljUIMx_tP2mWqnz4th5wlSq2Sr3imHF3hfKc9HFU-qWyLRm0BLWC_OArxazGtm1Z0T9XKpIYRbT902rTb1ItVzj3NiJ55xJ6Ze4W6UzJyr_u1DdMFQ4u9Uqixe2h0T08d0rjyaq1qDIoLNeVH3eS-7-NX-pD84LS3cdpqfZWm-9HoudHzeZ6P0xNdw0bPlGvgKI2eL69Gz6VSvcobBP-ah5xwm8J_VeB0-JB3cRAOKOl33eDvDlP0cGOADgdenGSKkLwPHCgWyFJe6XCNnvU4ABoyPCgFNBgHBtnAqPEJqx6sdyPz4Nc2T-51hhhDsUNj8H2nEG-9-r2nfEz6TwAAAP__Urqikw) after the USDA's National Veterinary Services Laboratories in Ames, Iowa, confirmed the sample. Texas State Veterinarian Bud Dinges swiftly established a 12-mile quarantine zone, barring any warm-blooded animal from leaving without inspection. Officials stressed the food supply faces no risk. Screwworm larvae burrow into open wounds on living animals but [do not infest processed meat](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SpDAMhU9jMlOyAIMDB5uQ9aYbUgLLjWsNdBlP0337KZipucBkT39P-vTvNtwoxLDe_9LCNr_8Nqx87JFz5nTKY0vR7VO61BLWzC_a5wEBtQQtoRkchfge6sLZEZxRBVvVdqCbtsK6mK0iNKy8MxqNd21TtZXWTJ0D06jJmyLY0ww0NEoBQlUiOOOpAurGadRaiRrYhbylMs987ffxvT05ldO2FNHOOT92Uf0R2Avsj-Mo_z8_-CwK7CnlMEUW2J9cAvs9Uz7Dy0h-J1c-5EUqf1DlV0Pix5YyOznRfo6hNpLAK4dayVF1layN7mSneJJExOBr7rhxRbLucYQYw65bUcN9oRCvg_Pv3vy0-BkAAP__oJ2RnA). Rollins said no other U.S. cases have been detected, and the infected calf is expected to recover. To contain the spread, the USDA has been [dropping millions of sterile flies](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAQgJ8GO8wwKmpB8Td2-7dXGoRxJYewEXbZffuLFvcC133JJPPNN1-3-aadd-H-X--k8nuNc6CSPOVMx4klHt4mc1y0u5DprdM2I6DkIDl0s9XOf-a2smoBO4qKlOgHkF3fYFttCrW04yhQklxNK5AsdLbpx0GgHkYzVE6dy0BCJwQgNDWCHVfdgB4Ws0gpWAtkXY5HnTe6_Kv_xBcdtYl75dWW8yOx5h_DieFUSqm_3zqcQ4bTWcNweiaruQ4hPoOhxB8xJbd44oEKvxL5byN3YSWTXQzcBZ7iM2_8sjKcqkPZR3HeuyR71sJ9185fZ-S_Pe-l8CcAAP__d5WHJQ) into the region--the same technique used to eradicate screwworm from the U.S. in the 1970s. Texas leads the nation in cattle production, and industry leaders have been sounding alarms about the parasite's northward march through Mexico for more than a year.

Texas State Veterinarian Bud Dinges swiftly established a 12-mile quarantine zone, barring any warm-blooded animal from leaving without inspection. Officials stressed the food supply faces no risk. Screwworm larvae burrow into open wounds on living animals but . Rollins said no other U.S. cases have been detected, and the infected calf is expected to recover. To contain the spread, the USDA has been into the region--the same technique used to eradicate screwworm from the U.S. in the 1970s. #### Teichert in the Trenches - June 2026
Welcome to this month's installment of Teichert in the Trenches, a monthly newsletter highlighting a snippet of my attempts to maximize my impact on people and our great nation and to develop the leaders our nation needs!

#### **_Teichert in the News_**
---
It continues to be an ever-changing situation in the Middle East, and in order to avoid older news, I’ve only included a couple of the more recent interviews here. As always, you can watch a more extensive range of hits on my You Tube page.

🇺🇲 🇮🇱 🇮🇷 Thoughts on the potential deal with Iran (May 24, 2026).

📺 Thanks to Molly Line and Fox News for the chance to share my thoughts on the potential deal with Iran. We must:
✅ Be careful as they are notorious for negotiating in bad faith
✅ Realize that the devil is in the details and purgatory is in the phasing
| | | | [ ](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG13EXv1dZJgdaBrW9hw/SnHOd9gLPGy7)
---
I spent a fair amount of time with my friend Leland Vittert on NewsNation this month. Here are some thoughts about the need to emphasize using airpower to achieve strategic objectives (May 26, 2026).✅ I strongly recommend you start following his free Substack at the link below.
| [ Leland Vittert - "War Notes"](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeG7uggjyojTAjPUbUSIC/pMiHmX0Y7y4C)
---
| | | **_Thoughts by Teichert_**
---
|
---
| | | 🇺🇲 The power of friendships, partnerships, and collaboration – at the individual and national levels!

🇪🇸 🇫🇷 On May 2, 1776, the nations of Spain and France each committed the equivalent of million dollars in weapons and ammunition to the American revolutionary cause. Such a commitment provided badly needed equipment to the Americans who had faced a tough year of fighting against the British, but more importantly this commitment encouraged and emboldened the colonists as well.

8️⃣ Eight days later, riding the wave of support from their allies, the Second Continental Congress voted to allow the formation of independent colonial governments.

✅ Two months later, the encouraged and emboldened American colonies approved the Declaration of Independence.
📣 Life is not a solo sport; neither is leadership or governance. We all need the equipping, encouraging, and emboldening that comes with strong, trusting relationships. All too often our rugged independence, a positive characteristic in many situations, causes us to neglect such relationships and try to solve our problems on our own. In doing so, we lose an important force multiplier that comes with friendships, partnerships, and collaborations.
🖼️ The picture is of the Lee Resolution, proposed on June 7, 1776.

🎥 Thanks to Mike Emanuel and Fox News for teeing up a great question for the Nightcap segment of the show a few weeks ago. I have an entire chapter of BOOM related to this topic, and it was a great opportunity to provide a very abbreviated summary of those thoughts!

For the want of a shoe, the horse was lost,
For the want of a horse, the rider was lost,
For the want of a rider, the battle was lost,
For the want of a battle, the kingdom was lost,
And all for the want of a horseshoe-nail!

| | | 🦀 Maryland Family Matters!

🇺🇲 A massive thanks to Jeff Trimbath for your leadership of the Maryland Family Institute. I was honored to join you on your most recent podcast, talking about the key issues of:
✅ Hope
✅ Trust
✅ Faith
✅ Service

⏰ We covered all of that in 21 minutes!
---
|
---
👽 🚀 Key lessons from a discussion about aliens!

🇺🇲 🇷🇺 Former Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev shared a previously unknown story about President Ronald Reagan in 2009. During their first meeting together in 1985 and in the presence of only one another and their interpreters, Reagan opened with a seemingly strange question: “What would you do if the United States were suddenly attacked by someone from outer space? Would you help us?” Gorbachev responded immediately: “No doubt about it.” Reagan replied: “We would too.”

📣 These leaders then moved on to more directly relevant business, buoyed by an understanding that they were not absolute enemies and uplifted by a tone of trust. If they could work together in the case of an alien attack, then just maybe there was more common ground to explore. This simple conversation started became the springboard for a mutually beneficial relationship that changed the world.

💥 Trust is the catalyst for progress. the lynchpin of productivity, and the adhesive of community. It is a force multiplier, a well-being magnifier, and a profit booster. Yet, our cynical society prompts us to demonize one another. Distrust has become a barrier to progress, an undercutter of productivity, and a repellant of community. It has become a costly multifaceted drag on society.

🔥 Our trustworthiness and a willingness to trust others are key traits for mutual benefit and societal success!

🙏 Thanks to Ian Bremmer for the Reagan/Gorbachev story in his book “The Power of Crisis”

Meets the Moment](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGZMVG1nXO576ihZNedE/MQGdubuEyy2O)
---
🇺🇲 “Either you succeed, right here as patriots in this country, or our warriors will not!” (May 21, Real Clear Defense)

📣 We need American manufacturing that meets the moment!

💥 “Except for situations requiring mass production of one product for decades, a single-use factory should be a thing of the past. Instead, an easily reconfigurable process allows for maximum, modular output. Digital manufacturing slashes part count, hacks away at development and production timelines, and minimizes component mass. And through it all, the factory itself has become a weapon with a next-generation competitive advantage to leapfrog our competitors and reclaim manufacturing dominance.”

🙏 Thanks to Divergent Technologies for showing the way back to manufacturing dominance for the USA!
| [ Striking at the Heart
of Iran](https://eufi5.r.sp1-brevo.net/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeGgDxOqkiYEbCY0JLxDU/LH54GyG4QV7Y)
---
🇺🇲 📣 “Anything else suboptimizes the use of force.” (May 27, Real Clear Politics)

💥 “President Trump has stated that any extension of the cease fire would be a good deal or no deal at all. In lieu of a deal that firmly meets U.S. strategic interests, it’s time to end the ceasefire and engage in a strategic interdiction campaign to strike at the heart of the Iranian regime. Carefully selected and precisely targeted regime strongholds, internal security sites, energy facilities, and transportation corridors should top the list of targets. Long awaited military activity against Kharg Island would be particularly potent, hitting at the preeminent source of Iran’s ability to fund itself and its malign interests.”
|
---
| | | 🔥 Good Revenge That Overcomes the Absurdity of Current Culture!

📷 Hessy Levinsons Taft died a few months ago at age 91. She lived a normal life, with the most notoriety of her nine decades occurring when she was just an infant. It was during that time that she was selected by Nazi Propaganda Minister Joseph Goebbels as the most Aryan-looking baby of 1935. Her baby picture was prominently plastered across the reach of the German regime.

🕍 The twist of irony of this dubious honor stems from the fact that Hessy was Jewish.

✡️ The photographer of her baby pictures, knowing she was Jewish, intentionally entered her in the contest to subtly demonstrate the absurdity of Nazi culture. Hessy in her later years referred to this act of defiance as “good revenge.”

📣 We are never going to transform a modern-day culture by joining in its absurdity, mean-spirited revenge, hate, and crudeness!

💥 Instead, we are to provide a stark contrast, offering saltiness to overcome the unappetizing lack of savour and light to overcome the suffocating darkness. We are to be such sterling examples of refreshing and distinct goodness and beauty that even the other side can’t help displaying our portraits of character.

🎆 Like Hessy’s picture, portraits of character provide the ideal means of “good revenge” to counter a culture of absurdity! ** _Teichert in the Trenches_**

---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2433%2E259176%2EvrUKVU) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2433%2E259176%2EvrUKVU)_

Congresswoman Sharice Davids here — Blue Amp Action told me I could reach out with a special message for Pride. I’m proud to be the first openly LGBTQ+ Native American woman ever elected to Congress. I’m proud that I’ve broken the mold of what a typical background is for a member of Congress. And I’m proud to work my heart out every single day to fight back against discrimination and injustice. [**If you’re with me in this fight, then I am humbly asking you to chip in a split donation between my campaign in must-win Kansas’ 3rd and Blue Amp Action — because, truly, there is so much on the line in this year’s election, including the fundamental freedom to live who we are, openly and proudly.**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/13451?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.05_Davids-Pride_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=5&akid=2433%2E259176%2EvrUKVU) | [DONATE](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/13451?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.05_Davids-Pride_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=6&akid=2433%2E259176%2EvrUKVU)
---
I couldn’t be more proud to serve as one of just a handful of openly LGBTQ+ voices in Congress.
**But things aren’t easy right now. Not in Congress. Not anywhere else.**
Today, National Republicans are more emboldened than ever to treat LGBTQ+ kids as political pawns, to fear-monger about our community, and put LGBTQ+ Americans in danger just to score cheap political points.
**But if there’s one thing I know, it’s this:** I’ve seen the persistence and determination of the LGBTQ+ community. And I know we can keep pushing our country forward, despite all the forces trying to drag us backward.
[**Now, I’m asking you to join me in that fight — not for my own sake, but for your neighbors, your loved ones, and millions of LGBTQ+ Americans across the country who deserve leaders willing to stand up for them. Please, will you chip in $25, $5, even $1 — split between our campaign and Blue Amp Action — to help us keep up the fight in Washington?**](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/13451?source=LOC_EM_FR_2026.06.05_Davids-Pride_B1_F1_S1_C1_90AC-365DON_N-T0&t=7&akid=2433%2E259176%2EvrUKVU)
Thank you so much for your support, and Happy Pride!
\- Sharice

| | | Friend,
---
What I wouldn't give for one more love letter from Charlie.

One more handwritten note left beside my coffee before he rushed out the door.

One more folded piece of paper on my pillow before he had an early flight.

One more moment where he intentionally set aside the noise of the world just to remind me that I was loved.

About this time last year, Charlie and I sat together on-stage at the Women's Leadership Summit (WLS), answering questions from young women about marriage, family, faith, raising children, and the kind of future they hoped to have one day.
---
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b6279a691c1449a9871922a07ce82934&_e=I7rh-IMFGCRfRLJCcMKl5QbqHRs9HWwA49xK4NTyntwmzqT5eSTeysrTbuJ96WzXPOSaJly29Eof0QrWZ_ExlNnpu3tpmO_QmSigAL8p94IlPGla2D2fNINC-f0CjfZkzSUjZr30iMMEfYehAToCoO8WZAl-rFd2zVhsiMpcg0slceVrsFSHh5k79e-P8pUU5Kwb0jEM-OuLcHH67agDHq4Cpb9lVCc8Pna3D8d8ohkBlrUmZgTdU-A0Xita7qs3i9EfuxLJYCXfi-cYHwAdu5wqwPhtxqZQu5YplyZ3v584710aS8FZWYpTJ_H6uu2vId-79iD814SF7qOvF3Ylioej-AUX_PNK3NrhA4lW6NMT3oIm_xyeaEJbs4DxxAbURvxaZGTLATqfczjhmeM5kAlakDtGFs9Uyl6nY9DQqkeR2KCZgzIHhpGxlfUMraIo9EQ3NtcAtKcwjH-dqnpclZN5A3khPWIfrTgeUDp_cBjfwBP7l2gRZSNiSpgg0LGmT9E4w2i2ZGUfnZn8JxzsK8MURk2ApO3qLCFH_6VxttSfhRZsUcJOdacZlMqatWQ_kfPU3M59NHUx52KEg9BSm5QAwHfidYp7yDw155bAmfgW4sw4D0LMJ4Fcj8f7IflzwDd7Iy1Is_he1ecZN5RVlrdy47DdNCNu-CVBgU4Y6rLRXCxopu42nbwedXt5SDE7XVqdsBD_1Js52-AqVvB_Tk0AgvYbopwgSQQvedIxK9PYAodk4SXekFxrgYJmmOJo)
---
Somewhere during that conversation, I mentioned the notes he would write to me.

They were one of the many quiet ways Charlie loved me.

I shared that he would write them whenever he had a moment while he honored the Sabbath.

_He never missed one. _

Sometimes they were only a few sentences, but they carried such a deep reverence about them. He'd hand me words that felt sacred.

I saved every single one of those letters.
---
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b6279a691c1449a9871922a07ce82934&_e=I7rh-IMFGCRfRLJCcMKl5QbqHRs9HWwA49xK4NTyntwmzqT5eSTeysrTbuJ96WzXPOSaJly29Eof0QrWZ_ExlNnpu3tpmO_QmSigAL8p94IlPGla2D2fNINC-f0CjfZkzSUjZr30iMMEfYehAToCoO8WZAl-rFd2zVhsiMpcg0slceVrsFSHh5k79e-P8pUU5Kwb0jEM-OuLcHH67agDHq4Cpb9lVCc8Pna3D8d8ohkBlrUmZgTdU-A0Xita7qs3i9EfuxLJYCXfi-cYHwAdu8-GkKeXYLQqe6xBvNjK6K98L8o0l7PCCAQdbthUdN1wgwMxyqsSQTGtSiVESOGdwEWSPCAgmPw80eWVEcmZmJxfYaV9JZiaAUi1bTgGXJ0Ra8GP9YEjBJaKzQJQAh6eM41ZI0xs_HlXwOep89L0zFbD9Ffs2b0te-Pked2fCDf_rQjbtwkA1TzsJ52EE8ralNRBrIHe97UZnGAvSNOk51oSypL51c44PZOJ2G2qUk8ZG6JwKUbeZQfRcnULA_YxCoPoG0074WdSa7LI1s9Ts1C9OZNgDCsk-G4ohSfyjlqPkadtzz7igfRiJkExs3350l9Y1Y1ur9RY7Fths8G_TmRePoS7PaMs-MHRPzNZjWDkbwxmz76xkOB7M82FrSJTunhrNHWiwKcDjwSeAoa94AVRLBUKUz8GWxwnRln9uXbpbhj3zAQ5rbTykpaRi7NFKI-AtbzYHHO2jBMTkQPfS4L1_tlGvrYvdLzFsGXBavck)

Charlie knew how much those little notes meant to me, and now I treasure them in a way I never could have understood at the time.

I hold onto every word he left for me.

And looking back, I think about the young women in the room listening to us that night at the Women's Leadership Summit.

Because so many of those young women were longing for something this culture keeps trying to convince them no longer matters.

A strong family. A faithful marriage. Children raised in a home filled with purpose and love.

A life rooted in God instead of endless striving and the empty pursuit of self.

And honestly, Friend, I think that ache runs much deeper than most people realize.

I see it constantly when I meet young women across the country.

So many feel exhausted by the pressure to chase an image of success that leaves them anxious, disconnected, and lonely.

They've been told that fulfillment comes from constant achievement... endless comparison... putting themselves first.

But as I said last year, the enemy has a way of disguising bondage as empowerment.

I think that's part of why so many young women are drawn to the Women's Leadership Summit in the first place.

Because for one weekend, thousands of young women come together and realize they are not alone for wanting a different kind of life.

They meet other young women who still love God, still believe family matters, and still want meaningful lives rooted in faith and purpose.
---
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b6279a691c1449a9871922a07ce82934&_e=I7rh-IMFGCRfRLJCcMKl5QbqHRs9HWwA49xK4NTyntwmzqT5eSTeysrTbuJ96WzXPOSaJly29Eof0QrWZ_ExlNnpu3tpmO_QmSigAL8p94IlPGla2D2fNINC-f0CjfZkzSUjZr30iMMEfYehAToCoO8WZAl-rFd2zVhsiMpcg0slceVrsFSHh5k79e-P8pUU5Kwb0jEM-OuLcHH67agDHq4Cpb9lVCc8Pna3D8d8ohkBlrUmZgTdU-A0Xita7qs3i9EfuxLJYCXfi-cYHwAdu4siRYWbqZQBj0_uziyIiHna693yKMiIVkPjFIfJ83MuIB3R1aP7HA9q_5LFFqO_22pZz_KLcGmyJikoC0ge5Gwb_TpPO_yyj13dVmKnqu0k8qkZQD8D1OxODM86Sw6KtTH64DKGZdgC3MbAxUvukX4BwUvUFITaQJ3v3CDGIJC9Fq3hQBgY4Y4XY2mEOSwkIK2vD7vswxAkcNLvjRuUKhmdPJhpwRcdKWFMXf2d3DcwiAG-9MG-p3Dw7UDfIXC8JvF_aWuy7dU_v7KJLibXwrHLq7KoNaxSQr00DF9MT1_YcWgzrvVW3-uh76in70p0r-dh6f-4nhezc3ukLtxGOhZmTw99KTHfc5mLJGojnhE2B8Mxzgd9EiFsy34I7-fsFM3iC5sOh0wfNvjZ3UDTfivihQLyaWP_-J3gLcghk1AlpTuMmczrthhPgLKW-1sK7F-WFQQSqMSuBJFKDKTn3y6uz0C5yUfltFRZ58pCY_Se)
---
Last year during our question-and-answer session at the Women's Leadership Summit, one young woman walked up to the microphone... and Charlie recognized her immediately.

Before she could even ask her question, Charlie's face lit up with a huge smile as he said, _" Hey! So... you're getting married!" _

The room burst into cheers as she smiled and nodded her head.

And then Charlie reminded everyone why he recognized her in the first place.

The year before, she had stood at the mic and asked him a simple question:

_" How do I meet a husband?" _

A year later, she came back to WLS engaged.

I smile thinking about how excited everyone in that room was for her.

I see moments like that every year at the Women's Leadership Summit. And after I leave, I always carry home a deep sense of hope about this next generation of young women.

Not because they have everything figured out.

But because so many of them are still searching for what is true, and for who God designed them to be.

Revival is not going to come through louder politicians or more influencers.

It's going to come through the living rooms of mothers who pray with their children, pray over their children, and love their husbands. And through bold actions of unshakeable devotion to Jesus Christ.

I believe the way a woman loves her family, raises her children, serves others, and walks with God leaves a mark on the world far greater than most people will ever realize.

That's why this event matters so deeply to me.

And when I think back on my own life, I know how true that is.

Before I met Charlie, I was not dreaming about marriage, motherhood, and building a family.

But when I met the right man, everything shifted. Everything changed.

And before doors open in San Antonio for the Women's Leadership Summit this June, I just want to thank you for helping make this event possible year after year.

Thank you for helping us continue pouring into these young women.

Thank you for helping carry forward a mission that changes so many lives -- including mine.

I truly cannot wait to see what God does through this next generation of young women.
---
| | | **For Charlie,**** ****Erika Kirk** CEO & ChairTurning Point USA

**P.S.** Looking back now, I think some of the moments that leave the deepest mark on your life are the ones you almost don't realize are sacred while you're living them.

A love note on Saturday. A prayer before bed. A husband asking how he can better serve you.

You don't realize until much later that those small acts of love and faithfulness were quietly building something eternal inside your home.

I read all of Charlie's love letters even slower now.

And as I read his words, the weight on my heart reminds me that we were never promised gray hair and rocking chairs -- even though we assumed it was guaranteed.

Charlie and I built our marriage around the kind of covenant described in Ephesians 5 -- rooted in faith, sacrifice, service, and putting Christ at the center of our home.

And it's another reason why Charlie cared so deeply about our nation's young people -- both men and women.

He wanted them to know there is still meaning to be found in building a beautiful life rooted in the things that actually last.

Get married.
Have children.
Build a legacy.
Pass down your values.
Pursue the eternal.
Seek true joy.

That kind of life may not be what this culture celebrates anymore... but I still believe with my whole heart that it is the life so many young women are quietly searching for.

As the Women's Leadership Summit approaches, I'm deeply grateful for people like you who help us continue to create a place where they can encounter that kind of faith, encouragement, and purpose.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you.

clean_body: I read them even slower now... | | | | | | | Friend, What I wouldn't give for one more love letter from Charlie. One more handwritten note left beside my coffee before he rushed out the door. One more folded piece of paper on my pillow before he had an early flight. One more moment where he intentionally set aside the noise of the world just to remind me that I was loved. About this time last year, Charlie and I sat together on-stage at the Women's Leadership Summit (WLS), answering questions from young women about marriage, family, faith, raising children, and the kind of future they hoped to have one day. Somewhere during that conversation, I mentioned the notes he would write to me. They were one of the many quiet ways Charlie loved me. I shared that he would write them whenever he had a moment while he honored the Sabbath. He never missed one. Sometimes they were only a few sentences, but they carried such a deep reverence about them. He'd hand me words that felt sacred. I saved every single one of those letters. Charlie knew how much those little notes meant to me, and now I treasure them in a way I never could have understood at the time. I hold onto every word he left for me. And looking back, I think about the young women in the room listening to us that night at the Women's Leadership Summit. Because so many of those young women were longing for something this culture keeps trying to convince them no longer matters. A strong family. A faithful marriage. Children raised in a home filled with purpose and love. A life rooted in God instead of endless striving and the empty pursuit of self. And honestly, Friend, I think that ache runs much deeper than most people realize. I see it constantly when I meet young women across the country. So many feel exhausted by the pressure to chase an image of success that leaves them anxious, disconnected, and lonely. They've been told that fulfillment comes from constant achievement... endless comparison... putting themselves first. But as I said last year, the enemy has a way of disguising bondage as empowerment. I think that's part of why so many young women are drawn to the Women's Leadership Summit in the first place. Because for one weekend, thousands of young women come together and realize they are not alone for wanting a different kind of life. They meet other young women who still love God, still believe family matters, and still want meaningful lives rooted in faith and purpose. Last year during our question-and-answer session at the Women's Leadership Summit, one young woman walked up to the microphone... and Charlie recognized her immediately. Before she could even ask her question, Charlie's face lit up with a huge smile as he said, " Hey! So... you're getting married!" The room burst into cheers as she smiled and nodded her head. And then Charlie reminded everyone why he recognized her in the first place. The year before, she had stood at the mic and asked him a simple question: " How do I meet a husband?" And after I leave, I always carry home a deep sense of hope about this next generation of young women. Not because they have everything figured out. But because so many of them are still searching for what is true, and for who God designed them to be. Revival is not going to come through louder politicians or more influencers. It's going to come through the living rooms of mothers who pray with their children, pray over their children, and love their husbands. And through bold actions of unshakeable devotion to Jesus Christ. ## Border Funded: Senate Muscles Through $70 Billion ICE Package in Pre-Dawn Win for Trump
After weeks of stalling, the Senate delivered. In a marathon overnight session that ended just before **5 a.m. Friday** , Republicans pushed through a sweeping **$70 billion** bill to fund Immigration and Customs Enforcement and the Border Patrol — a major victory for President Trump's enforcement agenda.The vote was **52-47**. Senate Republicans used a procedural maneuver to get around the filibuster and passed the package with no Democratic votes. The money funds the agencies for three years — locking them in **through the end of Trump's term** and shielding them from future shutdown brawls.What's Happening
* The bill now heads to the **House** for final passage. Some Republicans say it may be Trump's last big legislative win before the midterms.
* Only one Republican — Alaska's **Lisa Murkowski** — broke ranks to vote no.
* The package survived repeated attempts to strip out a **$1.8 billion Justice Department fund** Trump backed to compensate Americans who say the federal government targeted them.

Why It MattersDemocrats spent weeks blocking the bill, demanding new restraints on federal agents. In the end, the funding sailed through intact. ## Peace or Pressure? Iran Ceasefire Deal Now Sits on Trump's Desk
The biggest foreign-policy decision of the year is down to one man's signature. Negotiators have largely agreed to a **60-day memorandum** to extend the U.S.-Iran ceasefire and reopen the Strait of Hormuz — but President Trump is taking his time, refusing to sign anything that doesn't meet his red lines.The Terms
* Iran **must agree** it will never possess a nuclear weapon, Trump insists.
* The **Strait of Hormuz** — the chokepoint for roughly a fifth of the world's oil — must reopen to unrestricted shipping.
* The memo would extend the truce 60 days and tee up a fresh round of talks on Iran's nuclear program.

The SituationTrump convened his national security team in the Situation Room to make a "final determination," then ended the meeting without announcing one — classic leverage. Iranian state media has already pushed back on his demands. The president, for his part, has signaled he's in no rush, making clear he'll only take a deal that's good for America.Read the full story at [CBS News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_PMx2qeeRMJxkulIYhfBCSXn0YojNvqwoqGfGsQD903J994mONep3riCRrNDiZIgjSwzksy2fVA5Ckk0F-yGVi5SZxV70NhGuA6-egrGV4fE61izkLXuPoxQFE-upJ2ADyIX6qftxvP8LyM9DGNPz9PGF-BXtcaJVG8jGlMe4DYkp-5STzv9ZkB84n551vPLw_i5XwVYah2Hsoi5UY2qpFVF-PiT68Aa8xxaQai3tRzHNQ2p9Ji92rXzq9lHkdGGDkPlC9NTuIMCvSuw3lxexkXcygI_3gaXihDqX04HqsokwFHv-kxc6roxE4OruKAnBFciFy8KupPqIrSan48TfJs/4r8/2nxOn4AnRX-IUofaVTf84g/h4/h001.EDJ020eDJr2kZQLB5ubLK0FvR14Jjw0_tJuuHfOY7gQ).

★ The Economy
## Oil Cools, Hope Heats Up: Crude Tumbles 20% From Its 2026 Peak
Here's the silver lining for every American watching the pump. Global oil prices have **fallen roughly 20%** from their 2026 highs as markets bet a lasting Iran ceasefire will finally unclog the Strait of Hormuz and get crude flowing again.The Numbers
* **Brent crude** slid back near the low-$90s, after posting its worst month since the COVID era.
* U.S. **West Texas Intermediate** dropped double digits month-to-date.
* Pump prices remain elevated — around **$4.26 a gallon** nationally — but relief is in sight if the deal holds.

The CatchAnalysts warn the rebound won't be instant. Crude loadings inside the Gulf are still running far below normal, and it takes time for supply to recover even once the shooting stops. But the direction is clear: peace at the negotiating table means cheaper energy for working families — and that's a win Washington can't spin away.Read the full story at [CNBC](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_PAdCoyg8A3gk9Sl_cgtTs3onP7jpwInNs9khUQi9cynF1QWjq8P8nVVGwNdFAm6zH05yB7WsHtSGfZ9BMJVtm0yzLUdkW8FFvpV6I38Ec3WTpzHJ85uF2U7Cwj780mD6wESlzUrnhdpUKYjL09qJCKBlzhk2CLh9MYUXBMwR2haAkLy3vtzeyWmKsCotjaozGRS8MIB4PDdg5-bEXulFiTJ-sWM7lH3YqBZG-QAYrgVgjumiom2lC9abFE70I5OWt_EY83LSVqQGDkc0hQTLKbVSkQ3BxMzGU39nKE0AmEK-otHr3y88x1EF8DANxs5uw/4r8/2nxOn4AnRX-IUofaVTf84g/h5/h001.X-p6p1Jo210IJ5v4-qccRw131vOwopiGey_YFQJWdJc).

## Primary Fallout: Outsiders Are Winning, and the Establishment Is Sweating
Tuesday's coast-to-coast primaries are still being counted, but the message is already loud and clear — voters in both parties want fighters, not figureheads. The results are scrambling assumptions ahead of November.What Happened
* In **California** , Trump-endorsed Steve Hilton surged to the front of a 60-candidate field to replace Gavin Newsom, putting a Republican in serious contention in the bluest state in America.
* In **Iowa** , farmer and outsider **Zach Lahn** edged Trump-backed Rep. Randy Feenstra **37.8% to 37%** in the GOP governor's primary — proof the grassroots will buck even a presidential endorsement.

The PerspectiveThe through-line from Sacramento to Des Moines is anti-establishment energy. Lahn ran on saving family farms from hedge funds and foreign buyers; Hilton ran on cutting gas prices, fees, and taxes. When candidates speak to the cost of living, voters listen — regardless of which party's machine is backing whom.Read the full story at [NBC News](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.SfPhhFqVdCCzAqIAosiI_Hww93iPI4LJrShhMJMeWsBwwLRkiqL8TVbHKcIylW_-RcSKHh4avkXMzm7QRbEIbn3wJq4LwXpaHpLYGgYlb__QIKdb1E8jC15IKIFiKv1P_sPGleRGn5EvI7MNanBizIQyWRJFP79HuZwxH3PsPx9rZ4kREc-gyxj770UFNvTXKhYrTXhjr6uCSSNhOkW1gEJ5mHjY8bVtcHhK1k3JfqRcDv0C1uy4j_0YwZjllS1JPlmNuLngd5SidxAyVxPPigqZz6-DFleXdxryQDmt9gWo1OJi0oUfT0D1jfp-WAieFYUYb3DT0pTVyyw7t9eqV-LUS6FJPzJmppmdtxpJ1Cs/4r8/2nxOn4AnRX-IUofaVTf84g/h6/h001.uPMci_tbhPrH1yYl8qaRKtHYk2O_Hm-YgZqd8VRAw20).⚡ The Bottom LineIt was a banner night for the border and a patient hand on Iran — Trump funded his enforcement agenda for years to come while refusing to sign a Middle East deal that doesn't put America first. Oil is falling, peace is on the table, and primary voters keep rewarding fighters who talk about kitchen-table costs. **Leverage abroad, results at home, and an electorate that's done with business as usual.** "The truth isn't conservative or liberal. In Iowa , farmer and outsider Zach Lahn edged Trump-backed Rep. Randy Feenstra 37.8% to 37% in the GOP governor's primary — proof the grassroots will buck even a presidential endorsement. The PerspectiveThe through-line from Sacramento to Des Moines is anti-establishment energy. Lahn ran on saving family farms from hedge funds and foreign buyers; Hilton ran on cutting gas prices, fees, and taxes. When candidates speak to the cost of living, voters listen — regardless of which party's machine is backing whom.Read the full story at .⚡ The Bottom LineIt was a banner night for the border and a patient hand on Iran — Trump funded his enforcement agenda for years to come while refusing to sign a Middle East deal that doesn't put America first. Oil is falling, peace is on the table, and primary voters keep rewarding fighters who talk about kitchen-table costs. Leverage abroad, results at home, and an electorate that's done with business as usual. "The truth isn't conservative or liberal. It's just the truth."This newsletter presents news from a conservative perspective. We encourage seeking multiple sources. Just The Truth 6547 N Academy Blvd #2436 | Colorado Springs, CO 80918

body:

[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/13678?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&t=8&akid=1652%2E124072%2EiDJdis)

subject: Let me be blunt about New Hampshire.

body:

Governor JB Pritzker here.
Let me be blunt: **_Everything we care about is on the line in 2026 — and New Hampshire could decide the outcome._**
We’ve already seen the damage Trump’s second term is inflicting on our country: His ICE agents are once again targeting families in broad daylight -- tearing apart communities, rounding up workers, and instilling fear across entire neighborhoods. He’s gutting environmental protections while utility rates spike, forcing working families to foot the bill so his billionaire donors can cash out.
He has no interest in bipartisanship, decency, or democracy. **And if Democrats don’t take back the Senate this November, there will be nothing stopping him.** That’s why we _must_ win in New Hampshire.
**[Chris Pappas is running in a tied race that could decide Senate control. Chip in $5 now to help him win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260605_1.l6WEaB&refcode=em20260605-1&t=2&akid=7014%2E582294%2EhdDGx9)**
Trump and his MAGA allies are laser-focused on New Hampshire. They’ve recruited a big-name candidate, they’re lining up GOP billionaire donors, and they know if they win here, they’ll shut the door on a Democratic Senate majority.
We can’t let that happen.
Chris Pappas is a fighter. He’s taken on Big Pharma, defended reproductive freedom, and delivered for working families in one of the toughest districts in the country.
I want him in the Senate. But we’re all going to have to come together to get him there. He’s running in a true battleground. His race is tied. And the GOP machine, desperate to keep Democrats locked out of power, is ready to bury him in dark money and attack ads.
**[That’s why I’m asking-- urgently -- for your help: Can you chip in $5 to help Chris Pappas win in New Hampshire and give us a fighting chance to stop Trump?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260605_1.l6WEaB&refcode=em20260605-1&t=3&akid=7014%2E582294%2EhdDGx9)**

The damage is real. The stakes are massive. And the time to act is right now.
Thank you for standing with Chris and for standing up to the madness.
JB Pritzker
Governor of Illinois

subject: [Add your name] Keep Illegal Handguns Out of the Mail Act
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

**We have an important favor to ask of you today.**
Several House Democrats just introduced a bill to block the USPS from mailing handguns. This comes as the Trump administration is trying to urge the USPS to change its rules.
If Donald Trump’s plans go into effect, it would open up a new gun trafficking channel and make it significantly easier for guns to fall into the wrong hands. We need to act ASAP.
[**Will you sign on as a citizen co-sponsor to the _Keep Illegal Handguns Out of the Mail Act_ today? We need to send a message to the Trump administration and the USPS that we are united in keeping dangerous guns out of our communities.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_keepillegalgunsoutofmailact_q22026/?source=em260605-1-b&refcode2=11526.3935704.gy3jjy&akid=11526%2E3935704%2Egy3jjy)
**[ADD MY NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_keepillegalgunsoutofmailact_q22026//?source=em260605-1-b&refcode2=11526.3935704.gy3jjy&akid=11526%2E3935704%2Egy3jjy)**
If you need a refresher, federal law has prohibited the United States Postal Service (USPS) from carrying or delivering handguns as mail since 1927 — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, and licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
Donald Trump is trying to change that. Earlier this year, his Department of Justice issued a memorandum saying that they would no longer enforce this ban.
Now, the USPS is proposing a change to their existing regulations. This attempt by the Trump administration would weaken our background check system, endanger USPS workers, and interfere with gun tracing for violent crimes.
Our leaders should be keeping us safe — and this is a step in the wrong direction. But the fight isn’t over.
[**Will you please add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of the _Keep Illegal Handguns Out of the Mail Act_?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_keepillegalgunsoutofmailact_q22026/?source=em260605-1-b&refcode2=11526.3935704.gy3jjy&akid=11526%2E3935704%2Egy3jjy)
**[ADD MY NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_keepillegalgunsoutofmailact_q22026//?source=em260605-1-b&refcode2=11526.3935704.gy3jjy&akid=11526%2E3935704%2Egy3jjy)**
Thank you,
GIFFORDS

We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1&akid=11526%2E3935704%2Egy3jjy) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

name: Julie Jaman
subject: Patriot, the YMCA banned me for protecting girls – now we’ve won
body:
I fought the YMCA after they banned me for protecting girls in the locker room and won a $65,000 settlement. Help us keep fighting.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e926053/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvR3N5ajdBc1pjRg/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjA2MDU/LbmNsTEVZSWF6bw/qP2hpZHM9bmNEWlFTbEVZSG5ZeVhscw/gaiLNrQ/s0t99860e02)
| | |
---
| | | Patriot _,_
---
What if this happened to you, your daughter, or your granddaughter? I’m 84 years old, and for many years I trusted the government-owned pool that the YMCA operated near me as a safe place for women and girls. **Until one day.**

I was taking a shower in the women’s locker room after a swim and when I heard a man's voice, I pulled back the curtain to look. **I couldn’t believe my eyes.** A biological man dressed in a women’s swimsuit, was standing with two young girls, helping one of them remove her swimsuit so she could use the toilet. Shocked and concerned for those little girls, I did what any protective woman would do.

I spoke up and asked him to leave the women’s space. The YMCA’s response?
**They punished me.** They called my concern **“discriminatory,”** banned me for life from all their facilities, and even called the police on **me,** not the man in the locker room.
---

_**by Lawrence Winnerman**_
2026 is a hell of a year.
It's the 250th birthday of the American experiment. It's the midterm election that decides whether the experiment gets a 251st. It's the year _Grand Theft Auto VI_ --a video game about stealing everything that isn't nailed down--is projected to clear $3 billion, possibly the biggest entertainment launch in human history.
And it's the year roughly $4 trillion in private capital converged on three companies as they lined up to go public.
Anthropic, the makers of Claude. OpenAI, the makers of ChatGPT. And SpaceX, the maker of rocket ships and satellites and AI and whatever else Elon Musk has welded into his unholy alliance this quarter.
Here's the first thing you need to know about these three companies: _they lose money_. **Not a little money --massive, historic, oceanic amounts of money. **
They are on the spending spree of the century, pouring billions into data centers the size of small towns and, in SpaceX's case, into pieces of rocket ships that usually don't explode.
And here's the second, which is the one I want you to sit with for this entire essay. The same political class that has spent forty years insisting there was no money for housing, or health care, or child care, found $4 trillion for _this_ --instantly, and without anyone having to ask how we'd pay for it.
By the end of this piece, I'm going to show you that the scarcity they've sold us since the Reagan years was never a fact about the world. It was a choice about where the money was allowed to go.
Let me walk you through how I know that.
# The Filings
Here are the confirmed facts, in filings three weeks apart.
On June 1, 2026, **Anthropic** confidentially filed for an IPO, with a potential October debut. Days earlier it had closed a Series H round, raising $65 billion and valuing the company at $965 billion--nearly the first $1 trillion private company ever. To feel the velocity: in March of 2025, all of Anthropic was valued at $61.5 billion. About fourteen months later, that number is sixteen times higher.
On May 22, 2026, **OpenAI** confidentially filed an S-1--the SEC paperwork that begins an IPO, the document where a company finally has to open its books--targeting a September listing above $1 trillion. OpenAI still projects roughly a $14 billion loss in 2026 alone, and has said out loud, in public, that it does not anticipate being profitable until 2030.
**SpaceX** filed in May 2026, reportedly seeking up to $75 billion in new funding at a valuation of $1.8 trillion--more than twice the largest IPO in history. SpaceX posted a $4.28 billion net loss in the first quarter of 2026, with an accumulated deficit of $41.3 billion, largely driven by its AI operations.
Three companies, within weeks of each other, each valued at or above $1 trillion. Nearly $4 trillion in combined valuation.
Now hold that against the size of the thing it's happening inside. The entire U.S. economy is about $30 trillion. These three companies, which mostly lose money, are claiming a combined value equal to roughly **one-eighth of everything the United States produces in a year** --before a single share has traded publicly.
So here's the big question: where do $4 trillion new dollars come from?
How does that much money get manifested out of thin air?
